settings.style.label: Indicator style
settings.style.description: One marker per column. The focused app highlights its column.
settings.dot_size.label: Dot size
settings.dot_spacing.label: Dot spacing
settings.dot_spacing.description: Space between dots in logical pixels.
settings.segment_length.label: Line segment length
settings.segment_length.description: Length per column in logical pixels. Use zero segment gap for a continuous line.
settings.line_thickness.label: Line thickness
settings.use_theme_colors.label: Use theme colors
settings.use_theme_colors.description: Use the theme primary color for focus and its secondary text color for other columns.
settings.focused_color.label: Focused column color
settings.focused_color.description: Color of the column containing the focused app.
settings.inactive_color.label: Other columns color
settings.inactive_color.description: Color of columns that do not contain the focused app.
settings.alignment.label: Alignment
settings.alignment.description: Top and bottom on horizontal bars; left and right on vertical bars.
settings.alignment_size.label: Alignment height / width
settings.alignment_size.description: Match your bar thickness in logical pixels. Divide by the widget scale if you scale this widget.
settings.edge_inset.label: Edge inset
settings.edge_inset.description: Space from the selected edge in logical pixels.
settings.line_gap.label: Line segment gap
settings.line_gap.description: Keep at zero for a continuous line, or increase for separate dashes.
settings.line_radius.label: Line corner radius
settings.line_radius.description: Zero gives square corners. Larger values round each segment.
settings.dot_shape.label: Dot shape
settings.fill_inactive_dots.label: Fill inactive dots
settings.fill_inactive_dots.description: Fill all dots instead of outlining inactive columns.
settings.inactive_opacity.label: Inactive opacity
settings.inactive_opacity.description: Lower the opacity of columns that do not contain the focused app.
settings.animations.label: Transition animations
settings.animations.description: Animate focus changes and fade in new columns. Respects Noctalia’s global animation setting.
settings.animation_duration.label: Transition duration (ms)
settings.animation_duration.description: Duration before applying Noctalia’s global animation speed. For Bouncy, sets the spring response time; settling can take longer.
settings.animation_style.label: Animation style
settings.animation_style.description: Choose how the focus highlight moves between columns.
settings.animation_curve.label: Animation curve
settings.animation_curve.description: Choose the pace of the transition. Applies to focus and column fade-ins.
settings.outer_radius.label: Outer edge radius
settings.outer_radius.description: Rounds only the outside ends of the line; internal joins keep the segment radius.
settings.hover_use_theme_color.label: Use theme hover color
settings.hover_use_theme_color.descripti: Use the theme foreground color for the hover cover.
settings.hover_color.label: Hover cover color
settings.hover_opacity.label: Hover cover opacity
settings.hover_opacity.description: Zero hides the cover while keeping window-title tooltips.
settings.hover_coverage.label: Hover cover length (%)
settings.hover_coverage.description: Percentage of the segment length covered, centered within the segment.
settings.hover_thickness.label: Hover cover thickness
settings.hover_thickness.description: Cross-bar size in logical pixels. Zero follows the marker size.
settings.hover_radius.label: Hover cover radius
settings.hover_radius.description: Corner rounding of the hover cover in logical pixels.
settings.curve_power.label: Easing power
settings.curve_power.description: Higher values make acceleration or deceleration more pronounced.
settings.curve_exponential.label: Exponential strength
settings.curve_exponential.description: Higher values move faster at the start and settle more slowly.
settings.curve_bounce_strength.label: Bounce depth
settings.curve_bounce_strength.descripti: Spring rebound strength. Zero settles without overshooting; higher values give a deeper, softer rebound.
settings.curve_x1.label: Bézier X1
settings.curve_x1.description: Time coordinate of the first control point.
settings.curve_y1.label: Bézier Y1
settings.curve_y1.description: Progress coordinate of the first control point.
settings.curve_x2.label: Bézier X2
settings.curve_x2.description: Time coordinate of the second control point.
settings.curve_y2.label: Bézier Y2
settings.curve_y2.description: Progress coordinate of the second control point.
settings.slide_fluidity.label: Slide stretch
settings.slide_fluidity.description: With Bouncy, the leading edge moves ahead while the trailing edge catches up. Zero keeps a fixed-length highlight.
